Q1.rationale: The NDA contains no grant or denial of any right or licence to Confidential Information, so the term is not addressed.
Q1.label: NotMentioned

Q2.rationale: Clause 3 bars disclosure to any other person, and the only regulator-related carve-out (clause 22) covers legally compelled disclosure with prior notice, not voluntary reports of violations.
Q2.label: Contradiction

Q3.rationale: Clauses 1(a) and 1(c) define Confidential Information by its nature and subject matter, with no requirement that it be expressly identified.
Q3.label: Contradiction

Q4.rationale: The NDA restricts disclosure and keeps information confidential but contains no express use restriction limited to stated purposes.
Q4.label: NotMentioned

Q5.rationale: The NDA does not address copying or reproduction of Confidential Information.
Q5.label: NotMentioned

Q6.rationale: Clause 1(a) contemplates information being provided to the Disclosee's employees as Representatives, subject to clause 3 awareness requirements.
Q6.label: Entailment

Q7.rationale: Clause 3 expressly contemplates disclosure to professional advisors, and Representatives include financial, legal and tax advisors.
Q7.label: Entailment

Q8.rationale: Clause 1(c) treats the fact of the negotiations and any fact concerning the Sale as Confidential Information.
Q8.label: Entailment

Q9.rationale: Clauses 17 to 19 set a fixed duration that expires on the earlier of three years or completion of the Sale, with no survival or termination clause.
Q9.label: NotMentioned

Q10.rationale: Clause 22 requires the Disclosee to notify the Sellers immediately before disclosing when legally compelled.
Q10.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: Clause 21 provides a US$500,000 penalty payable on any breach, irrespective of actual loss.
Q11.label: Entailment

Q12.rationale: The NDA contains no export control provision.
Q12.label: NotMentioned

Q13.rationale: The NDA contains no reverse engineering prohibition.
Q13.label: NotMentioned

Q14.rationale: Clause 10(b) excludes prior lawful possession, but the NDA does not address acquiring similar information from third parties.
Q14.label: NotMentioned

Q15.rationale: Clause 1(a) expressly covers information in oral form.
Q15.label: Entailment

Q16.rationale: Clause 28 expressly limits Confidential Information to technical information and excludes business or financial information, although clause 1(a) is broader.
Q16.label: Entailment
